rationale: Every step builds job-relevant skills for employment (applies to all skills)
Data skills feed reliable evidence for decisions
Measuring and estimating produce usable data
Care and accessibility skills help include people who are often left out
Serving the public well includes those who need extra help
Clear communication with the public widens who can use a service
Explaining information widens public access to it
Digital skills drive productivity through technology
Monitoring resources is how waste gets cut
Inspection keeps infrastructure and equipment safe
Good judgement is the part of work that stays with people
